sentences.cn_text: 来吧——大家都在这么做。
sentences.en_text: Come on — Everybody’s doing it.

sentences.cn_text: 那种低声的暗示，半是邀请半是强迫，正是我们大多数人听到「同伴压力」一词时所想到的东西。
sentences.en_text: That whispered message, half invitation and half forcing, is what most of us think of when we hear the words peer pressure.

sentences.cn_text: 它通常不会带来什么好结果——酗酒、吸毒和随意性行为。
sentences.en_text: It usually leads to no good — drinking, drugs and casual sex.

sentences.cn_text: 但在她的新书《加入俱乐部》中,蒂娜·罗森伯格认为,同伴压力也可以成为一种积极力量,她称之为「社会疗法」,即组织和官员利用群体动力来帮助个人改善生活,甚至可能改变世界。
sentences.en_text: But in her new book Join the Club, Tina Rosenberg contends that peer pressure can also be a positive force through what she calls the social cure, in which organizations and officials use the power of group dynamics to help individuals improve their lives and possibly the world.

sentences.cn_text: 罗森伯格是普利策奖得主,她列举了大量社会疗法的实践案例:在南卡罗来纳州,一个名为「对抗烟雾」的州政府资助反吸烟项目致力于让香烟变得不酷。
sentences.en_text: Rosenberg, the recipient of a Pulitzer Prize, offers a host of examples of the social cure in action: In South Carolina, a state-sponsored antismoking program called Rage Against the Haze sets out to make cigarettes uncool.

sentences.cn_text: 在南非,一个名为「爱生活」的艾滋病预防项目招募年轻人在同龄人中推广安全性行为。
sentences.en_text: In South Africa, an HIV-prevention initiative known as loveLife recruits young people to promote safe sex among their peers.

sentences.cn_text: 这一想法看起来颇有前景,而罗森伯格是一位敏锐的观察者。
sentences.en_text: The idea seems promising, and Rosenberg is a perceptive observer.

sentences.cn_text: 她对许多公共卫生运动乏力现象的批评切中要害:这些运动未能调动同伴压力来促进健康习惯,并且暴露出对心理学的严重误读。
sentences.en_text: Her critique of the lameness of many public-health campaigns is spot-on: they fail to mobilize peer pressure for healthy habits, and they demonstrate a seriously flawed understanding of psychology.

sentences.cn_text: 「敢于与众不同,请不要吸烟!」一个旨在减少青少年吸烟的广告牌活动如此呼吁——而青少年最渴望的恰恰是融入群体。
sentences.en_text: “Dare to be different, please don’t smoke!” pleads one billboard campaign aimed at reducing smoking among teenagers — teenagers, who desire nothing more than fitting in.

sentences.cn_text: 罗森伯格令人信服地指出,公共卫生倡导者应该向精于运用同伴压力的广告商学习经验。
sentences.en_text: Rosenberg argues convincingly that public-health advocates ought to take a page from advertisers, so skilled at applying peer pressure.

sentences.cn_text: 但在社会疗法的总体有效性问题上,罗森伯格的论证不那么令人信服。
sentences.en_text: But on the general effectiveness of the social cure, Rosenberg is less persuasive.

sentences.cn_text: 《加入俱乐部》充斥着过多无关细节,却对使同伴压力如此强大的社会和生物因素探讨不足。
sentences.en_text: Join the Club is filled with too much irrelevant detail and not enough exploration of the social and biological factors that make peer pressure so powerful.

sentences.cn_text: 书中所呈现的社会疗法最明显的缺陷在于,它无法长期保持良好效果。
sentences.en_text: The most glaring flaw of the social cure as it’s presented here is that it doesn’t work very well for very long.

sentences.cn_text: 「对抗烟雾」项目在州政府削减资金后便宣告失败。
sentences.en_text: Rage Against the Haze failed once state funding was cut.

sentences.cn_text: 有关「爱生活」项目能否产生持久变化的证据既有限又不一致。
sentences.en_text: Evidence that the loveLife program produces lasting changes is limited and mixed.

sentences.cn_text: 毫无疑问,我们的同伴群体对我们的行为产生巨大影响。
sentences.en_text: There’s no doubt that our peer groups exert enormous influence on our behavior.

sentences.cn_text: 大量新兴研究表明,积极的健康习惯——以及消极的习惯——都会通过社交传播在朋友网络中扩散。
sentences.en_text: An emerging body of research shows that positive health habits — as well as negative ones — spread through networks of friends via social communication.

sentences.cn_text: 这是一种微妙的同伴压力形式:我们会无意识地模仿每天所见的行为。
sentences.en_text: This is a subtle form of peer pressure: we unconsciously imitate the behavior we see every day.

sentences.cn_text: 然而,专家和官僚能否成功地为我们选择同伴群体并将其活动引向良性方向,这远不确定。
sentences.en_text: Far less certain, however, is how successfully experts and bureaucrats can select our peer groups and steer their activities in virtuous directions.

sentences.cn_text: 这就像老师通过将后排的捣乱者与表现较好的同学配对来拆散他们。
sentences.en_text: It’s like the teacher who breaks up the troublemakers in the back row by pairing them with better-behaved classmates.

sentences.cn_text: 这种策略从未真正奏效过。
sentences.en_text: The tactic never really works.

sentences.cn_text: 这正是外部设计的社会疗法的问题所在:在现实世界中,正如在学校里,我们坚持自己选择朋友。
sentences.en_text: And that’s the problem with a social cure engineered from the outside: in the real world, as in school, we insist on choosing our own friends.

sentences.cn_text: 根据第一段,同伴压力通常表现为____
sentences.en_text: According to the first paragraph, peer pressure often emerges as ____

sentences.cn_text: 社会疗法的补充
sentences.en_text: a supplement to the social cure.

sentences.cn_text: 群体动力的刺激因素
sentences.en_text: a stimulus to group dynamics.

sentences.cn_text: 社会进步的障碍
sentences.en_text: an obstacle to social progress.

sentences.cn_text: 不良行为的诱因
sentences.en_text: a cause of undesirable behaviors.

sentences.cn_text: 罗森伯格认为公共卫生倡导者应该____
sentences.en_text: Rosenberg holds that public-health advocates should ____

sentences.cn_text: 聘请专业广告人员
sentences.en_text: recruit professional advertisers.

sentences.cn_text: 借鉴广告商的经验
sentences.en_text: learn from advertisers’ experience.

sentences.cn_text: 远离商业广告商
sentences.en_text: stay away from commercial advertisers.

sentences.cn_text: 认识到广告的局限性
sentences.en_text: recognize the limitations of advertisements.

sentences.cn_text: 在作者看来,罗森伯格的书未能____
sentences.en_text: In the author’s view, Rosenberg’s book fails to ____

sentences.cn_text: 充分探究社会和生物因素
sentences.en_text: adequately probe social and biological factors.

sentences.cn_text: 有效规避社会疗法的缺陷
sentences.en_text: effectively evade the flaws of the social cure.

sentences.cn_text: 阐明政府资助的作用
sentences.en_text: illustrate the functions of state funding.

sentences.cn_text: 产生持久的社会效应
sentences.en_text: produce a long-lasting social effect.

sentences.cn_text: 第五段表明,我们对行为的模仿____
sentences.en_text: Paragraph 5 shows that our imitation of behaviors ____

sentences.cn_text: 对我们的朋友网络有害
sentences.en_text: is harmful to our networks of friends.

sentences.cn_text: 会误导行为研究
sentences.en_text: will mislead behavioral studies.

sentences.cn_text: 在不知不觉中发生
sentences.en_text: occurs without our realizing it.

sentences.cn_text: 可能产生不良健康习惯
sentences.en_text: can produce negative health habits.

sentences.cn_text: 作者在最后一段暗示,同伴压力的作用是____
sentences.en_text: The author suggests in the last paragraph that the effect of peer pressure is ____

sentences.cn_text: 有害的
sentences.en_text: harmful.

sentences.cn_text: 可取的
sentences.en_text: desirable.

sentences.cn_text: 深远的
sentences.en_text: profound.

sentences.cn_text: 存疑的
sentences.en_text: questionable.
